name: firebase-tests
description: Firestore security rules emulator tests for spec.md #6a (Social). MUST be run from the REPO ROOT (not this dir) so firebase-tools picks up ../firebase.json (which points at ../firestore.rules) — see the run command below and docs/firebase-setup.md.

scripts.test: echo 'Run from the repo root instead: JAVA_HOME=<jdk21+> firebase-tests/node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:exec --project demo-mindmeld-rules-test --only firestore "node firebase-tests/rules.test.js"' && exit 1
